CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

August 13, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:01 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra
  City Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: July 23, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the July 23, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger
  Noes:  None
  Abstain:  Ng
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  1617-1621 West Shorb Street, DRB-2024-00057

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 3 ft. high wrought-iron fence within the
  front yard setback, a new 6 ft. high vinyl fence on the side property line, and new
  patio railing and handrails.
  •  Applicant: Raymond Ho (absent) & Rebecca Tsang

  1
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval:
  1. The applicant shall confirm and revise the plans to show that the posts of
  the vinyl fence do not exceed 6 feet in height and that the posts of the
  wrought-iron fence
  2. do not exceed 3 feet in height. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set
  of drawings for the City Architect to verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall revise the first two (2) panels of the vinyl fence on the south
  side to be a 3 ft. high iron fence to match the proposed wrought-iron fence.
  2. The applicant shall confirm and revise the plans to show that the posts of the
  vinyl fence do not exceed 6 feet in height and that the posts of the wrought-
  iron fence do not exceed 3 feet in height.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  1721 South Granada Avenue, DRB-2024-00061

  •  Request: This is an application to rebuild an existing 6 ft. high CMU wall with
  stucco finish along the street side yard and replace an existing wrought-iron gate
  with a new metal and wood gate.
  •  Applicant: Frank Liu
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. The applicant shall update the gate graphic on callout #2 as shown on the
  plans to match the proposed gate product sheet.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  2
 ITEM 4:  16 West Main Street, DRB-2024-00075

  •  Request: This is an application for one (1) new wall-mounted sign and one (1)
  blade sign re-face on an existing 1-story commercial building for the business
  known as ‘Auntie Qiu Kitchen”.
  •  Applicant: Jasper Chang & Simon Stephanian
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval:

  1. Relocate the blade sign to the west side of the building frontage to establish a
  consistency throughout the commercial character of the neighborhood, while
  enabling future blade signs on neighboring buildings to comply with current
  zoning standards.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Relocate the blade sign to the west side of the building frontage to establish a
  consistency throughout the commercial character of the neighborhood, while
  enabling future blade signs on neighboring buildings to comply with current
  zoning standards.
  2. Update the project name to accurately spell the proposed business name,
  reading “Auntie Qiu Kitchen”.
  3. Revise the letter “i” in the sign rendering / elevation to accurately show the
  white edge color.
  4. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 5:  1301 West Valley Boulevard, DRB-2024-00007

  •  Request: This is an application for ten (10) new signs that include channel letters,
  logos, a clearance hanging sign, directional signage, and monument signs for a
  car wash business known as ‘Mister Car Wash’.
  •  Applicant: Miriam Hansen (absent) & Jose Fernandez
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following conditions of approval:

  1. The applicant shall revise the lighting method to illuminate monument sign
  that avoids direct light onto the public right-of-way, such as up-lighting from
  both sides where the light fixture may be concealed with landscaping.

  3
   2. Any signage not included in this plan must be removed or submitted for
  Planning and Design Review Board approval.
  3. The applicant shall reduce the scale and mass of the monument sign by
  reducing the overall height from 20 ft. to 15 ft.
  4. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect
  to verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Any signage not included in this plan must be removed or submitted for
  Planning and Design Review Board approval.
  2. The applicant shall scale down the overall size of the proposed monument
  sign and not to exceed 12 ft. in height.
  3. Revise the proposed rendering of the driveway canopy sign, Sign #6, to
  accurately illustrate what is proposed in terms of scale and
  lettering/characters.
  4. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect
  to verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:24 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on August 27, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:24 P.M.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
